connector.name: HS Code Classifier
connector.registryDescription: Classify products to official HS codes and validate supplier codes before customs submissions
connector.summary: Hosted at hs-code-classifier-mcp-server-production.up.railway.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package hs-code-classifier-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ojaskord account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
